author_instruction: 继续加数据，尝试做到 R2 > 0.6；利用 agent 集群提高效率。
disclosure: This shot is NOT blind. Before it was written the following readings existed: shot 13's full_table_hybrid 0.530028742596643, full_table_lever4 0.5433111678100043 and full_table_lever4_lever8 0.49147018524319047, and an exploratory 10-fold probe (probes/dielectric_target_scale_explore.py, status exploratory_not_promotable) which showed a log-epsilon target is far worse in epsilon space and was abandoned. The arm that this shot promotes had never been measured: the coordination block had only 88 of 148 pool compounds when shot 13 ran, and it now has 125.
diagnosis_being_tested: shot 13 read full_table_lever4 (0.5433) ABOVE full_table_lever4_lever8 (0.4915) and attributed it to coverage: the released coordination table covered 987 of 2029 training rows (88 of 148 compounds), so half the training matrix carried NaN in that block. probes/dielectric_coordination_block_full.py recomputed the same five columns for every pool compound under the same four-seed protocol and got 125 of 148 compounds ok.
second_lever_being_tested: the scored pool is 100 percent zero-frequency (static) permittivity, but the training pool also carries 435 rows whose property_name is 'Relative permittivity at various frequencies' (136 at <= 1 MHz and 299 above 1 MHz). Those are not static permittivities and they are used as training labels. A static-only training pool is a hygiene arm, not a new measurement.
decision_rule: co_primaries_met_with_governance  -- both co-primary arms above 0.60 AND Arm A passes (label placebo at or below the frozen baseline plus the placebo tolerance) AND Arm B passes (the training-row dose curve is monotone non-decreasing). co_primaries_met_governance_failed -- both above 0.60 but a governance arm fails. co_primaries_missed              -- at least one co-primary arm is at or below 0.60. No other arm may be promoted, whatever it reads, and no two readings from different pool definitions may be subtracted from one another.
reporting_duty: every arm, its delta against the frozen baseline and the pool definition it was measured on must be reported, including the arms that lose.
widened_block_rule: the widened arm adds only rows whose compound is already in the released pool (so the frozen feature block applies unchanged): record_kind == experimental, value a plain decimal (ranges dropped rather than guessed), 1.0 < epsilon <= 200, temperature in 273.15..353.15 K, and (inchikey, T_K) not already present in the released table. The Reaxys cards carry no frequency column, so these rows are low-frequency and uncalibrated and are used as training labels only, never as a scoring row.
